text: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと　まねして　かいて　みたの！

structure.jp: おとくな　けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと
structure.en: what was written on the handy notice board

patterns.name: 〜てある
patterns.explanation: てある after a verb says someone did it earlier and the result is still there. かいて　あった = 'was written there'.

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb says you do it to see how it goes. かいて　みた = 'tried writing'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと
patterns.explanation: A phrase ending in a verb placed right before a noun describes that noun. けいじばんに　かいて　あったこと = 'the thing that was written on the notice board'.
